name: TMS OS V15.3.6
notes: V15.3.6: He thong thong bao toast notification cho tat ca thao tac trong panel. Moi thao tac (Cloudflare, SQL Editor, Cai dat, File, Backup, dich vu...) bay gio hien trang thai dang toast noi tai vi tri thao tac, khong can cuon len dau trang xem nua.
features: Toast notification toan panel: success/error/warn/info voi icon rieng va mau rieng (xanh do/cam/xanh duong)
Stack toast bottom-right, tu dong an sau 3.5-5.5s, ho tro nhieu toast cung luc
Flash message tu server (POST truyen thong) tu dong chuyen thanh toast khi trang load (data-flash-toast)
Tich hop toast: Cloudflare Hosting (luu token, tao/dung/tach tunnel, gan ten mien), SQL Editor (luu/xoa/them dong, chay SQL), Brand logo (kiem tra dung luong file), Clear cache, Thong bao PWA

Tat ca view (Dashboard, Files, Database, Services, Updates, Backups, Websites, Network, Apps, Modules, Plugins, Guardian, Diagnostics, Terminal, Logs, Notifications, SQLEditor, Settings) deu da chuan hoa flash message thanh toast
CSS toast responsive: desktop 380px bottom-right, mobile full-width 12px le
Service Worker tms-os-v15-3-6: cap nhat cache moi, tu dong xoa cache cu khi update
changelog: Toast notification cho TAT CA thao tac panel: trang thai duoc hien dang toast noi tai vi tri thao tac, khong can cuon len dau trang xem nua.
